english.title: Use a motor vehicle on a road with a front projection of load / apparatus exceeding 2 metres
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[carrying a load,]_
(B)_[fitted with a special appliance or apparatus,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY LOAD OR APPARATUS..), which had a forward projection exceeding 2 metres but not exceeding 3.05 metres, when the conditions in paragraphs 2 and 3 of schedule 12 to the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 had not been complied with in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 82(7) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 82(7) does not apply to straddle carriers.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3346 and H3347.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) which was

(A)_[carrying]_

**(..SPECIFY LOAD OR APPLIANCE..) which had a forward projection of **(..SPECIFY PROJECTION..) metres and was not fitted with markers and no person was employed in attending the vehicle as required by regulation.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
